modules.title: API modules
modules.description: Weather Forecast and Air Quality are enough for most homes. Marine, flood, ensemble, seasonal, and extra sensor groups are optional.

groups.title: Variable groups
groups.description: Leave extras off unless you need pollen, solar, soil, or similar sensors. Temperature and forecasts stay on the weather entity.

settings.title: Units
settings.description: Creates a weather entity plus air quality, pollen, solar, and soil sensors. Temperature and forecasts stay on the weather entity. Extra APIs are under Configure.

modules.title: API modules
modules.description: Weather Forecast and Air Quality are enough for most homes. Only enable extras if you need them. Historical and climate data are actions, not sensors.

groups.title: Variable groups
groups.description: Hourly and daily forecasts live on the weather entity. Extra groups add more sensors; leave them off unless you need them.
